text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having narrowly missed victory in the Oka 
Sho, Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vowing not to let anyone steal the title 
of Queen of the Oaks, she burned with 
motivation to claim the tiara at the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks).
